name: miko-docs
description: Documentation site for Miko, a native cross-platform UI rendering engine for .NET.

scripts.docs:build: vitepress build docs && npm run docs:demo:build
scripts.docs:demo:build: node scripts/clean-docs-demo.mjs && dotnet publish examples/Docs/Miko.Docs.Demo.Browser/Miko.Docs.Demo.Browser.csproj -c Release && node scripts/stage-docs-demo.mjs
